offering_description.value: Develops and supplies paints, stains and coatings for buildings, vehicle manufacturing and refinishing, industrial equipment, metal packaging, and assets in infrastructure, energy and marine markets. It supplies aircraft transparencies and sealants, pavement markings and traffic safety products, and advanced materials for vision, document security, water reuse and displays. It also provides aircraft lifecycle and industrial asset protection services.
